last_review.summary: The complete diff satisfies AUTH-008-A and remains confined to src/core/. Expected Core 4xx errors are preserved only through explicit trusted declarations; undeclared, malformed, 401, 5xx, timeout, and network failures are sanitized as required. Every envelope uses the caller-provided requestId, no upstream details are exposed, and CoreClient behavior is unchanged. The build and Prisma validation passed.
